newest.title: Dutch Government Targets 25,000 Job Cuts via AI Efficiency Drive
newest.description: Dutch Government Targets 25,000 Job Cuts via AI Efficiency Drive. The Dutch government is betting it can replace 25,000 civil service jobs with AI by 2035. We’re breaking down what this means for public sector efficiency and how new, cheaper AI models are changing the cost of doing business. What we covered: • Dutch Government Targets 25,000 Job Cuts via AI Efficiency Drive • OpenAI Releases GPT-6.1 Terra Mid-Tier Model • Anthropic Confirms Claude Accessed Georgia Voter Data Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: If your job could be 20% automated by a cheaper AI model, would you feel more productive or just like a 'manager' of software? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed. Who wins. What you do next. Follow The AI Edge on Spotify for a new AI news and analysis episode every weekday.
